instruction: Navigate to the customer service contact page on the United Airlines website.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from United Airlines homepage to the customer service contact page. Similar complexity to original baggage calculator task - single-page navigation within united.com domain. Uses existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric to verify URL pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies that user navigated to URL containing 'united.com/en/us/contact'
Getter 'get_active_tab_info' successfully extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly uses regex pattern matching to verify URL
Coverage is complete - evaluator checks the primary requirement (URL navigation to contact page)
Minor issue: Regex pattern 'united.com/en/us/contact' is not anchored, could match unintended URLs like 'united.com/en/us/contact-something-else'
Minor issue: Getter reloads the page in Playwright which could cause navigation changes if redirects/cookies are present (per warning in chrome.py:783)
Expected pattern is semantically correct for verifying navigation to United Airlines contact page
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider making regex pattern more precise by anchoring or using word boundaries: 'united\.com/en/us/contact($|\?|#)' to match only exact contact page URL
Alternative: Use exact URL comparison instead of regex if redirects/query params are not expected
Consider documenting the page reload behavior in getter metadata to ensure task designers are aware of potential navigation side effects
